entries.title: Ask HN: How much do you make at Amazon? Here is how much I make at Amazon
entries.author: boren_ave11
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How much do you make at Amazon? Here is how much I make at Amazon
entries.excerpt: To people who work at Amazon, how much do you make? I work at Amazon, and my pay is below. Discussing pay is awkward, so most people don't. But this creates an imbalance of power in salary talks. A person I trust who was recently promoted was offered in the range of $55K for their new role. However, I know of one or two people who were hired into the same role from outside the company who apparently started at $70K+. I suspect that internal candidates have less leverage in pa
entries.guide_zh: 一位 Amazon 员工公开自己的薪酬，并邀请同事分享收入以改善谈薪信息差。

entries.title: Tell HN: AngelList told my employer that I'd updated my profile
entries.author: oliversisson
entries.current_title: Tell HN: AngelList told my employer that I'd updated my profile
entries.excerpt: I recently updated my AngelList profile and they emailed my employer, pretending to be me, to "confirm" the project I'd added. How can they think this is a good idea?
entries.guide_zh: 用户称更新 AngelList 资料后，平台冒用其身份向雇主发邮件确认项目。

entries.title: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (March 2016)
entries.author: whoishiring
entries.excerpt: Please lead with the location of the position and include the keywords REMOTE, INTERNS and/or VISA when the corresponding sort of candidate is welcome. When remote work is not an option, please include ONSITE. Submitters: please only post if you personally are part of the hiring company—no recruiting firms or job boards. Readers: please only email submitters if you personally are interested in the job—no recruiters or sales calls. You can also use kristopolous' nifty console
entries.guide_zh: 三月招聘信息交流，职位地点与远程等条件请在开头明确。

entries.title: Ask HN: What are some examples of beautiful software?
entries.author: ponderatul
entries.current_title: Ask HN: What are some examples of beautiful software?
entries.excerpt: So I've been reading Paul Graham's - Hackers and Painters. A bit late, I know. And I find his ideas fascinating. One that struck a chord with me, was the idea of taste, recognising good taste. I'd like to know examples of beautiful software and what makes it beautiful.
entries.guide_zh: 读《黑客与画家》后想找实例：有哪些软件可以称得上“美”？

entries.title: Ask HN: How much do you make at Google?
entries.author: googsomeday
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How much do you make at Google?
entries.excerpt: I don't work for Google, but I would like to. How much do senior software engineers make? What level are you? Do you work at Mountain View HQ, or elsewhere? I don't have much to share, but I make $130K base at a Silicon Valley startup. Options aren't worth anything (yet), but from what I've read on HN, they probably won't be worth anything anyways. (-: Thank you in advance for sharing! This post was inspired by an earlier post by an Amazon Employee: https://news.ycombinator.c
entries.guide_zh: 谷歌不同级别、不同地点的工程师，实际能获得怎样的薪酬？

entries.title: Ask HN: Moving Out of Silicon Valley because of housing? Where to?
entries.author: Apocryphon
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Moving Out of Silicon Valley because of housing? Where to?
entries.excerpt: Has anyone moved out of SF/SV to work in a different tech city? If so, where? Currently Seattle, New York, Austin, Portland, and Boston/Cambridge seem to be the hot destinations as secondary tech hubs. But their costs of living are likely climbing as well, especially Seattle and Austin. How about Raleigh, how's their startup scene? Or Chicago, Denver, New Orleans, or Nashville? Not to mention cities outside of the U.S.
entries.guide_zh: 因住房成本离开硅谷的人搬去了哪里，新城市的技术工作体验如何？
